name: A Fall from Grace
source:
Set in a fantasy world inspired by 1700’s England, follow Cedric, a nobleman coyote trying to live a life that might be too big for his pockets in a small country town. 

One evening, upon drinking with some close friends, everything is upended by a surprise encounter that will change his life forever. This is a story of following your own path, embracing your inner desires, and falling in love...

[From [url=https://projectnewmoon.itch.io/a-fall-from-grace]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
以1700年代英格兰为灵感的奇幻世界，跟随塞德里克，一只贵族土狼，试图在一个乡村小镇过上一种可能超出他口袋的生活。

一天晚上，在与一些亲密的朋友喝酒后，一场意外的邂逅彻底改变了一切，这将永远改变他的生活。这是一个追随自己的道路、拥抱内心的渴望、坠入爱河的故事……

[来自[url=https://projectnewmoon.itch.io/a-fall-from-grace]Itch.io[/url]]
